title: Korean-Style Roasted Sweet Potato Wedges with Sesame
summary: Sweet potato wedges are roasted until caramelised and tender, then tossed with sesame oil, sesame seeds and a gentle gochujang-style chilli kick. It is a vegan, honeyless Korean-inspired snack that works well warm from the oven.

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes, scrubbed and cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Line a large baking tray with baking paper, or use a non-stick tray.
Put the sweet potato wedges on the tray. Toss with the vegetable oil and salt, then spread them out in a single layer with space between the wedges.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the wedges are tender inside and browned at the edges.
Meanwhile, mix the sesame oil, soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger and chilli powder in a large bowl to make a glossy dressing.
Add the hot roasted wedges to the bowl and toss gently until coated. Sprinkle over the sesame seeds and toss again.
Transfer to a plate and finish with the sliced spring onions. Serve warm, while the edges are still slightly crisp.
